summary: Tested the telemetry bus, record/replay and rules-as-data refactor. Backend: 27/27 pytest pass (12 new rules/sessions tests + 15 existing). Frontend: all requested flows pass on Visor, Hallway, Rules and Baseline with no console or page errors: telemetry panel, SERIAL fallback with SIM tag, manual override, record, replay transport, branch, cross-scene load, export/import and rules hot reload. Found 4 minor recorder/event-logic issues. None blocks a flow.
verified: GET /api/rules returns {rules, version:int}. PUT returns 400 for a missing section, for bad observer_tiers ('x', [], missing min_load, non-dict items) and when throttle is not an object. A valid PUT persists and changes version. Original rules.json restored byte-for-byte.

Sessions: create, chunks posted out of order come back joined in idx order (ndjson content-type), list plus ?scene filter, size increments, no _id, delete removes session and chunks, 404s for unknown id on chunks/jsonl/delete.

Telemetry panel on visor and hallway: 16 rows (the 15 named channels plus imu_jitter; the request says 17, but the spec list has 16), each with value+unit, sim/replay/serial buttons, quality bar, sparkline and override toggle.

SERIAL on hr_bpm (hallway), stasis and cog_load (visor): within 0.7 s the live source shows 'SIM ⟲' and sim-tag-hr_bpm / sim-tag-stasis / sim-tag-cog_load appear. Switching back to SIM removes the tags.
Override cog_load to 95: hallway data-tier 0 -> 3; visor shows OBSERVER THROTTLE T2 and 95%, live source 'SIM · MAN'. Turning it off returns to the computed value (23%, tier 0).
Record dialog: name/notes, rec-badge, stop -> toast 'Session ... saved'. The session is listed in the sessions dialog with name, notes, scene, duration and line count.

Replay: badge and full transport present. 1x ~1050 ms per s, 2x ~1650 ms per s (deck refreshes every 200 ms, headless), 0.5x ~600 ms per s, pause gives 0 advance. Scrub to 5/30/50/95% gives lead 98/72/39/20 m and HR 65/75/88/94 from the recording. A live corridor reset during replay is ignored (lead stays at the replayed value). Channel routes switch to REPLAY.
Branch: badge removed, toast 'Branched live at 16.3 s', lead stays ~21 m (pre-branch 22 m) instead of jumping to 100. Routes are restored to SIM.
Cross-scene: loading a hallway session from the visor navigates to /hallway and replays there.
Export downloads TEST_hall_rec.g14.jsonl. Import adds it to the library (4 -> 5 items) and replays it. A bad file gives toast 'Import failed: Not a G-14 session file'.

File format: meta line {k:'meta', schema:'g14.session.v1', name, notes, scene}, s lines with all fields for all 16 channels, w lines with world+state, c lines, e lines (lure_start, throttle_tier, resist_result). ts is monotonic.

Rules page: editor shows JSON. Invalid JSON and missing sections show INVALID and disable Save. Revert works. Saving tier 1/2 min_load 10/15 shows toast and the hallway tier becomes 2. A PUT through the API restoring the original triggers 'Rules config hot-reloaded' and the tier goes back to 0 with no page reload.
Baseline: fast toggle works, baseline-source-em/thermal/imu show BUS then SIM, result BASELINE STABLE.
Units: BPM, SpO2 %, STASIS %, COG LOAD %, µT, °C shown on hallway vitals chip, telemetry edge and visor readouts.
Regression: visor contact cards and lure present. Hallway lure PULL 20% -> 0% with Space ('STEADYING · SLOW BREATH'). Manual run label shown. ANALYST cards render. No console errors.

minor.issue: Rewrites rules.json with json.dumps(indent=2), so the hand-formatted compact layout of the file is lost after the first in-app save. Cosmetic, but it makes the file harder to hand-edit. Consider keeping the formatting or documenting this.

integration_issues.issue: meta.rules_version is always null. useTelemetryEngine reads rulesRef.current?.version, but the pages pass only the `rules` object from useRules(); version is a separate context field.

No entity_spawn events are recorded for entities already on screen when recording starts. The event detector's `seen` set is filled before rec.start, so a visor recording had 0 events and a hallway recording had no spawn events. Fix: reset detectRef (makeEventDetector()) in startRecording, or emit spawn events for current entities at start.

resist_result is judged on the first frame AFTER Space is released (pull has already rebounded), so the result is biased toward BROKEN. Observed result BROKEN with pull 0.68 but peak_pull during resist 0.32. Judge on the last resisting frame's pull (or the min/avg during resist).

The first sample lines can have a negative ts (e.g. -19). rec.start uses performance.now(), but the RAF loop's `now` is the earlier frame timestamp. Harmless for replay; clamp ts at 0 or start on the next loop tick.

action_items: Pass the rules version into useTelemetryEngine (e.g. rules + version from useRules) so meta.rules_version is set
Reset the event detector (or emit spawn events for current entities) when recording starts, so sessions contain entity_spawn events
Judge resist_result on the last resisting frame's pull, not on the frame after release
critical_code_review_comments: telemetry.resolve: if route is replay/serial and latest[ch].sim is missing, `out` is undefined and `out.source` throws. Safe today because sim publishes every frame, but it is fragile for cog_load if compose ever skips publishing it
SessionsDialog delete has no error handling or confirm. LOAD/EXPORT fetch errors are unhandled promise rejections (no toast)
Branch does not restore the recorded HUD mode etc. unless the controls were recorded. OK by design, just noting
GET /api/sessions caps at 200 with no pagination. session_chunks has no index on (session_id, idx); add one for larger libraries

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (4 minor recorder/event-logic issues)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_hall_rec / TEST_visor_rec sessions plus one imported copy; all deleted, along with session 't'. Session 'smoke run' (pre-existing) kept. rules.json restored byte-identical to the original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use JS setter + input event to move replay-scrub (Playwright fill fails on range). In headless the recorder captures ~3 ticks/s (RAF slow). The drawer tab (controls/telemetry) persists when the panel is reopened. observer-throttle-indicator on the visor only renders when tier > 0. Back up rules.json bytes before PUT tests because PUT reformats the file.
